options.name: add_static_route
options.description: Whether to add an explicit static route for the remote inner tunnel address/subnet via the local tunnel address.

options.name: api_host
options.description: The hostname or IP address of the pfSense device.

options.name: api_key
options.description: An API key to use for authentication.

options.name: api_password
options.description: The password to authenticate with the pfSense API.

options.name: api_port
options.description: The port number of the pfSense API.

options.name: api_protocol
options.description: The protocol to use when connecting to the pfSense API.

options.name: api_username
options.description: The username to authenticate with the pfSense API.

options.name: descr
options.description: A description for this GRE interface.

options.name: if
options.description: The pfSense interface interface serving as the local address to be used for the GRE tunnel.

options.name: lookup_fields
options.description: The list of fields to use when looking up existing resources. This should be a list of field names that uniquely identify a resource.

options.name: remote_addr
options.description: The remote address to use for the GRE tunnel.

options.name: state
options.description: Whether the resource should be present or absent.

options.name: tunnel_local_addr
options.description: The local IPv4 address to use for the GRE tunnel.

options.name: tunnel_local_addr6
options.description: The local IPv6 address to use for the GRE tunnel.

options.name: tunnel_remote_addr
options.description: The remote IPv4 address to use for the GRE tunnel.

options.name: tunnel_remote_addr6
options.description: The remote IPv6 address to use for the GRE tunnel.

options.name: tunnel_remote_net
options.description: The remote IPv4 subnet bitmask to use for the GRE tunnel.

options.name: tunnel_remote_net6
options.description: The remote IPv6 subnet bitmask to use for the GRE tunnel.

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: Whether to validate SSL certificates when connecting to the API.
